Title: General Tool Friction Notes
Content: Friction points found while making MemorySmith use its own wiki, with current resolution status: (1) Local runs need a Development launch profile for static web assets — RESOLVED (launch profile configured); (2) MudBlazor providers must live in the interactive render tree — RESOLVED (long-standing stable pattern); (3) Source wiki data must be copied before tests mutate it — RESOLVED (ProjectWikiFixture.CopyToTemp() pattern in place); (4) On-disk JSON shape made friendlier — PARTIALLY RESOLVED (schema stable, migration framework added in TSK-0292). Remaining friction: MCP tools are shipped and active; semantic indexing and schema/version migration are ongoing work tracked in TSK-0304 (retrieval validation suite) and the semantic-search roadmap.
